title: The gate's -short run skips every end-to-end absorption test; only CI's full run exercises them
body: The absorb, cold re-derivation, recursion-bound and scoring fixtures all call shorttest.EndToEnd and are skipped under the gate's go test -short, so every tick of gvc closed behind a gate that never ran them. CI's non-short step covers them only on the epic PR. Consider a short, fixture-free test for the resume and cold-derivation invariants, or bind an [evidence.acceptance] command that runs the absorb tests without -short.
